changelog.category: Zero Gap Fix & Pitch Black Canvas Engine (v1.8.1)
items: Removed html root zoom to prevent browser viewport backdrop exposure.
Applied 92% zoom scaling to inner app container with 108.6956% width calculation.
Enforced #000000 pitch black background across html, body, main-content, and liquid bg canvas.
Completely eliminated side navy column gap and bottom gap.
Preserved 100% of music streaming and backend logic.
Bumped service worker cache version to v118.
